_comment: Turn-event tracking: read PITCHED_BLUE_CARD_THIS_TURN — private flag(s) nothing ever set, so the clause could never fire. The canonical keyword functions now record what happened this turn and EVENT_THIS_TURN reads it. The counter clause was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches. 'This ENTERS THE ARENA with a +1{p} counter' happens ONCE, on entry -- an ON_ENTER_PLAY trigger. As a continuous static it would have added a counter on every re-evaluation had it run at all. The Ward 2 static stays: Ward is one of the DECLARATIVE statics the engine reads straight off the CardDef.
